text.tspan: The control is not vanilla, so vanilla is not the baseline
​Non-conscious control minus off-the-shelf GPT-4.1. The format alone moves the model: against vanilla, every memory effect in this study would carry the opposite​
​sign. Flat rows sit at 0% for both.​
